gc_description: Applies retention to the JGates data folder and lists workspaces whose path no longer exists (deleting requires --yes).
gc_option_dry_run: Only lists what retention would delete.
gc_option_yes: Confirms and deletes what retention lists.
gc_option_max_age_days: Maximum age of runs in days (default 30, or JGATES_RETENTION_DAYS).
gc_option_max_workspace_mb: Maximum size of the runs of a workspace in MiB (default 2048, or JGATES_RETENTION_WORKSPACE_MB).
gc_option_max_total_mb: Maximum size of all runs in MiB (default 10240, or JGATES_RETENTION_TOTAL_MB).
gc_bad_number_fix: Use a number greater than or equal to zero.
gc_dry_and_yes_fix: Use --dry-run to list or --yes to delete.
gc_text_summary_dry: {count} run(s) would be deleted ({bytes} bytes). Use --yes to delete.
gc_text_summary_none: Nothing was deleted: use --yes to delete or --dry-run to list. {count} run(s) would be deleted ({bytes} bytes).
